name: Later: translucent materials, masked shadows, per-piece parameter values

comments.text: Done (D-265): a wired opacity mask bakes <name>.mask.frag and the shadow pass cuts the shadow with it (vent_grille); a wired opacity port makes the material translucent (alpha blend, no depth write, drawn after the sky, far to near; casts no shadow), sample sea_glass; SetEntityMaterialParameter gives one piece its own parameter values, carried on MeshRenderer and DrawItem. SetMaterialShader gained an options argument. Left: editor-set per-piece values saved with the level, overlapping see-through sorting, refraction.
